blocks.body:
## 如何阅读本 dashboard

香港加密生态由官方监管登记册锚定：金管局稳定币发行人沙盒（Anchorpoint FRS01、汇丰 FRS02）及证监会持牌 VATP 交易平台（OSL、HashKey）。券商（如国泰君安国际 01788.HK）仅具备虚拟资产交易服务许可，非 VATP 交易所运营商；Anchorpoint（Anchorpoint Financial，港元锚定 HKDAP）与 AnchorX（金涌投资 01328.HK，AxCNH）为不同主体。本 dashboard 跟踪监管登记册、港交所 ETF AUM 时间序列、全球稳定币供应走势、主要公链分布、DEX 交易量、加密情绪指数、BTC 价格长期走势、标签筛选的 Polymarket 催化剂、观察名单实时股价，以及前瞻性的监管新闻与公司公告（证监会、金管局、披露易），让即将发生的催化事件与历史快照并列呈现。本界面不提供投资建议。

source_health.label: HKMA Licensed Stablecoin Issuers Register
source_health.notes: Official ground-truth sandbox register of licensed stablecoin issuers (Anchorpoint FRS01, HSBC FRS02).

source_health.label: SFC Virtual Asset Trading Platforms Register
source_health.notes: Official 4-status SFC register of VATP exchange operators (licensed, pending, withdrawn, forced-closure).

source_health.label: DefiLlama Stablecoin & DEX Analytics API
source_health.notes: Global stablecoin supply, blockchain chain distribution, and daily DEX volume history.

source_health.label: HKEX Integrated Fund Platform ETF AUM API
source_health.notes: Monthly AUM history for Hong Kong spot Bitcoin and Ether ETFs.

source_health.label: Coinbase & Binance Public Tickers
source_health.notes: Real-time BTC spot price, long-run price history, and Coinbase Premium spread.

source_health.label: Crypto Fear & Greed Index (Alternative.me)
source_health.notes: Crypto-specific market sentiment index (0=Extreme Fear, 100=Extreme Greed) sourced from Alternative.me.

source_health.label: Polymarket Prediction Market API (Gamma API)
source_health.notes: Tag-filtered real-time prediction market probability for crypto and monetary policy regulatory catalysts.

source_health.label: SFC News & Announcements (Crypto-Filtered)
source_health.notes: SFC news and announcements over the trailing ~13 months, filtered to stablecoin/virtual-asset/crypto relevance by keyword.

source_health.label: HKMA Press Releases (Crypto-Filtered)
source_health.notes: HKMA official press releases over the trailing ~13 months, filtered to stablecoin/virtual-asset/crypto relevance by keyword.

source_health.label: HKEXnews Company Announcements (Watchlist Tickers)
source_health.notes: Company-filed announcements and disclosures for every HK Stablecoin & Crypto watchlist ticker over the trailing 90 days.

source_health.label: HK Watchlist Live Stock Quotes
source_health.notes: Latest live spot price, day change, and turnover for every HK Stablecoin & Crypto watchlist ticker.

source_health.label: Wikimedia Wikipedia Crypto Pageviews
source_health.notes: Daily English Wikipedia pageviews for a curated crypto/DeFi page basket, aggregated into complete Monday-Sunday weekly agent totals and monthly user-by-page history. This measures page-load attention, not unique people, trading activity, or Hong Kong adoption.
